mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board (member_id, trip_id, category, title, content) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{tripId},#{category},#{title},#{content})
mapper.select: SELECT b.board_id, b.member_id, b.trip_id, b.category, b.title, b.content, b.created_at, f.id AS file_id, f.original_name AS file_original_name, f.saved_name AS file_saved_name FROM board b LEFT JOIN board_file f ON b.board_id = f.board_id WHERE b.board_id = #{boardId}
SELECT board_id AS boardId, member_id AS memberId, title, created_at AS createdAt FROM board ORDER BY board_id DESC
SELECT board_id AS boardId, member_id AS memberId, trip_id AS tripId, category, title, content FROM board WHERE board_id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE board SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, member_id = #{memberId}, trip_id = #{tripId}, category = #{category} WHERE board_id = #{boardId}
mapper.select: SELECT board_id AS boardId, member_id AS memberId, title, created_at AS createdAt FROM board WHERE title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY board_id DESC
SELECT board_id AS boardId, member_id AS memberId, title, created_at AS createdAt FROM board WHERE member_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY board_id DESC
SELECT board_id AS boardId, member_id AS memberId, title, created_at AS createdAt FROM board WHERE content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY board_id DESC

SELECT b.board_id AS boardId, -- ⭐ 여기 b.title AS title, m.nickname AS writerName, b.created_at AS createdAt FROM board b JOIN member m ON b.member_id = m.member_id ORDER BY b.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
